data.one_liner: Provides detailed Windows system information via Dart.
data.what_it_does: The package exposes getters for user name, CPU, memory, disks, graphics, network, and other hardware details. It requires explicit initialization and can load only requested data to save time.
use_when: You need to display or log detailed Windows hardware info in a Flutter desktop app
You want to query system properties without writing native code
avoid_when: You target macOS, Linux, or mobile platforms
weaknesses: Windows‑only, no support for other OSes
Documentation is minimal and README is truncated
No example of error handling or async patterns
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, call WindowsSystemInfo.initWindowsInfo(), then access getters.

alternatives.name: win32
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides lower‑level Windows API access if you need more control or additional properties not exposed by windows_system_info
